visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a dark blue t-shirt and a woman in a tan button-down shirt stand side-by-side against a white wood-paneled wall. They look upward at a small video overlay showing a fitness demonstration of a man flexing. The lighting is bright and even across the room. (2) The video overlay disappears from the frame. The man lowers his gaze to his own right arm, gripping his bicep with his left hand. The woman stands close, observing his arm with a focused and slightly apprehensive facial expression while maintaining her posture. (3) The man exerts physical force to flex his arm muscles intensely. Immediately, the woman opens her mouth wide in a theatrical scream, her face contorting with exaggerated shock. The man looks toward her with a bewildered and startled expression, dropping his arm flex. (4) The video enters a fast-paced editing sequence with stylized motion. The woman screams again and suddenly lunges or falls out of the frame toward the bottom left. The man flinches, raising his hands to a defensive position near his face while looking startled.
